name: Alert
description: A static inline message with default and destructive variants. Icons are positioned automatically by the base class.
intent: A message that stays on the page because it remains true.

authority.note: src/ is authoritative. If this contract disagrees with the source, implement from the source and report the drift.

props.name: variant
props.hint: See variantGuidance in the mirror spec for when to use each.

props.name: className
props.hint: Merged with the component classes via cn(). Use for layout only — never to override a variant that already exists.

requiredAttributes: role="alert" is set on the root
notes: role="alert" is an assertive live region: it interrupts the screen reader. That is right for an error appearing in response to an action, and wrong for content present on page load — which will be announced over everything else.
For a message present at load, render a plain styled div instead, or use role="status".
The destructive variant must not rely on colour alone — keep the icon and the title.

forbiddenUsage: Colour as the only error signal
agentRules: Reserve destructive for errors and risks.
Always pair the variant with an icon and a title so colour is not the only signal.
For an alert present on page load, reconsider role="alert" — it will interrupt.
